name: 4-7-8 Breathing
equipment: A quiet space, seated or lying down
instructions: Sit or lie down, and rest the tip of your tongue behind your upper front teeth.
Exhale completely through your mouth with a soft whoosh sound.
Close your mouth and inhale quietly through your nose for a count of 4.
Hold your breath for a count of 7.
Exhale completely through your mouth for a count of 8, making the whoosh sound again.
Repeat for 4 rounds total, letting each cycle feel a little more settled than the last.
